name: Universal Institutional Equity Research
description: Build a sourced, scenario-based institutional equity research report for a listed company. Use for company analysis, stock valuation, financial statement analysis, comparable-company valuation, DCF or equity research reports.
author: Jairo Alonso González

runtime_requirements.python: optional for understanding; required for reproducible execution of included Python modules
runtime_requirements.network: required only for live external data retrieval
runtime_requirements.external_data_access: authorized provider, API, MCP server, browser or user-supplied dataset
runtime_requirements.file_generation: depends on agent runtime and installed format libraries

data_dependencies.name: Issuer filings and market data
data_dependencies.freshness: Verify retrieval timestamp and reporting period for each analysis

limitations: Passing package tests alone does not establish financial-domain accuracy, point-in-time integrity or production readiness.
